title: Kurotaro
text: “I’m gonna protect Itsuki! Ooh!”
“Ooh! That’s right!”
“You’re the enemy, though, Fleon.”
“It’s a little surreal, but it’s exciting. I wonder if you’ll pull out flying gadgets or doors that take us anywhere?”
“If we’re talking about flying, we’ve got Gaelion and Fleon, and you can teleport using weapons, right…?”
“That’s kind of sad when you think about it. That said, be sure to tell me later what the alchemical gadgets of the future are.”

The examples he gave are certainly all things we could technically do even now. However, perhaps Father’s curiosity has been piqued—he’s wearing the same cheerful expression he had when we first arrived in this other world. He had this same look on his face when he tried to recruit Panda, too.
“First off… how about a ‘Good Sleep Pillow’ that induces restful sleep? You can take a nap and recharge your energy.”
As Rafuemon rummaged around trying to pull something out, Ren circled around—as if he were the special effects guy—and began preparing his Flash Sword.
“Ren, you don’t have to go for the gimmicks.”
“Drawing attention to the tools is a great touch! I’ll help out too, just to learn from it!”
“Fleon, don’t jump on the bandwagon either!”
“Ahaha… things are getting lively. Rafu-emon for Itsuki, Motoyasu-kun for Philoko-chan, and Rafumi-chan for Ren, huh… It’s a shame no one’s coming to me.”
“I’m not happy about that.”
“I’m right here for you, Father!”
“Why is Motoyasu-kun trying to compete with me?”
“…You’re right about that. Speaking of coming from the future, Motoyasu-san is the one who traveled all the way from Naofumi-san’s future country, isn’t he?”

At Itsuki’s words, my Father turns his gaze toward me. Come on, come on! If you want to fly freely through the sky, I’ll take you up in Flying Mode. No matter what your wish may be, I’ll do my best to make it come true. Your happiness is my top priority!
“Hmm… You’ve helped me out a lot, but… Hey, Motoyasu-kun.”
“What is it?”
“Be prepared for a long lecture today, okay?”
Eek!? Is this going to be a lecture from my Father!?
“Here’s the ‘Good Night Pillow’!”

Just as they were about to say that, Ren and Fleon-chan—acting like they were in charge of the staging—made the prop they’d brought out glow. But because of the angle, a halo of light shone behind my Father, and my attention was completely focused on the lecture that was about to begin. The light that followed was quite striking. After all, despite that gentle, Mother-of-God-like smile, he was seething with anger.
And so, I was lectured by my Father for several hours. I was made to swear that I wouldn’t attack Ren or Itsuki over this matter.
A few hours later, after my Father’s lecture had ended, I checked on Black Thunder. Having recovered from the shock, Black Thunder was… wearing the thick glasses that Ren had been wearing.
“Shield Hero, is the farm looking okay like this?”
Black Thunder is taking the initiative to help maintain the farm. He’s never done anything like that before—what’s gotten into him?
“Black Thunder, what’s that? What’s going on?”
“I’m not Black Thunder… I’m Kurotarou…”

When my father asked, tilting his head in confusion, Black Thunder shyly introduced himself by the name he’d been given at the ranch. For some reason, he’s rubbing his hands together and fawning over my father.
“From now on, Kurotarou has decided to steadily practice Filolial farming. Shield Hero, please take good care of this Kurotarou.”
“Hmm…”
“What happened to the Jet-Black Twin Fangs!?　It’s the ‘The Love Hunter <TIME Drive>’!”
“I’ve outgrown that stuff. Besides, ‘The Love Hunter’ isn’t even read as ‘Time Drive’—it’s actually kind of lame… heh heh heh…”
Black Thunder let out a dry, self-deprecating laugh. What on earth is going on here!?
“How should I put it… it’s like he’s just followed in Ren’s footsteps exactly, graduated from middle-schooler syndrome, and moved straight into high-schooler syndrome.”
“Is this like… a high schooler who, after being crushed by their dreams, starts talking about aiming for a civil service job in search of stability?”
“Ah… the ‘I want to latch onto someone powerful’ type. It’s true that if he goes to Naofumi’s place, he probably won’t have to worry about putting food on the table…”
“Black Thunder! Pull yourself together! You can’t just keep getting beaten by that future Metal Tanuki Chocolate Monster!”
“W-wait, ‘getting beaten’… it’s n-not like that at all…”
Black Thunder looked away and dodged my words! This is serious! And I recognize these symptoms! They’re vaguely similar to how Kou acted when my Father scolded him!
“Father! Do you happen to know anyone—like Elephant or Big Sister—who might be able to help treat Black Thunder, who’s trembling with fear?”
“Well, even if you say that… Doesn’t Black Thunder—I mean, Kurotaro—know what he did wrong? The problem is forcing Ren to join when he clearly doesn’t want to…”

“I think the reason Rafumi didn’t show up in the world where the Awakening succeeded is because she hadn’t graduated yet, so she wasn’t feeling any resentment. And I think it also has to do with whether or not Fleon was there.”
“Gaelion-chan, that’s definitely a factor. Well, Kurotarou was causing trouble even among the village’s Filolials, so I think this was a good opportunity for him to calm down a bit.”
Ugh… It’s true that causing trouble for others is wrong—Filo-tan told me that in the first world, too. Black Thunder might have crossed a line he shouldn’t have… but still!
“That said, Bra… I mean, Kurotarou.”
“What is it, Shield Hero?”
“Personally, I don’t want to condemn the fact that he was trying to become the kind of person he thought was cool. I used to have those kinds of desires myself, you know?”
O-oh, Father is coming to Black Thunder’s defense. Just as I’d expect from Father. He scolds when he needs to, and praises the good points!
“So, as long as it doesn’t cause trouble for others, I think it’s fine to engage in that kind of play or pursue a cooler version of yourself. I mean, Ren basically likes that kind of thing, too.”
Ren started to deny it but fell silent. It’s a fact that he actually does like the Dark Holy Hero style. I suppose there are parts of it he can’t deny.
“So if you invite him to join in as long as it’s not something he’d hate, Ren will go along with it.”
“Got it!”

Black Thunder replied with a line that would make a delinquent’s underling nod in agreement. Hmm, I hope Father’s feelings got through to her… Just then, Yuki-chan returned from the Filolial producer’s place.
“I’m back. Oh? What happened?”
“Come to think of it, Yuki-chan had gone out to prepare for the next race, hadn’t she?”
“I wonder if it’s good luck or bad luck that I stayed out of this whole commotion…”
“Black Thunder seems a bit off, doesn’t he? Usually, he approaches me with that arrogant attitude, saying, ‘You’re a nice-looking female,’ whenever he gets the chance.”

After all, Yuki-chan wouldn’t even consider a slow male. Even White Swan—Yuki-chan from the first world—considered Black Thunder out of the question. That’s because Black Thunder is a Filolial-sama who places more emphasis on strength than anything else. From White Swan’s perspective, where speed is paramount, he probably wasn’t even considered a romantic prospect.

“A lot happened while Yuki-chan was away. I heard Black Thunder is graduating and going back to being Kurotaro. Apparently, he’ll be helping out with the farm work, so Yuki-chan, please keep an eye on him.”
“Oh? Is that so? Things will be a little quieter now, then.”
“Hmm, it’s just a fantasy where villains take over the village and we dashingly unleash our powers to save everyone… and since I’m the Hero, I wouldn’t even end up in that kind of crisis…”
“So that’s the Filolial version of a story where the school gets taken over by villains? Hmm… That’s a bit painful in its own way…”
“You wretch, Rafumi… The sin of turning Black Thunder into this is a grave one, you know.”

“I absolutely will take my revenge!” I swore to myself. But… to be honest, I’m actually a little wary of this Rafumi myself. The reason is probably that she reminds me of my Big Sister… Since the Raph-species themselves resemble my Big Sister, I’ve never actually fought them as enemies. My Big Sister is here in this loop, of course… but I’ll still make her take responsibility someday for what she did to Black Thunder. By the way, during this whole commotion, my Big Sisters were waiting safely inside the house.

“But… how should I put it? It felt like Fleon-chan and Black Thunder were exclusive Filolials for Itsuki and Ren, but now Rough-emon and Rough-mi-chan… they’ve come across as exclusive Raph-species, haven’t they?”
His father said to Itsuki with a wry smile.
“All I can say is that both of them are just meddling. Though I don’t really understand Philoko-san’s motives.”
“Filoko-chan… seems like she’s exclusive to both Fleon-chan and Motoyasu-kun. As for me… is it okay if I’m just ‘Raph-chan’?”
“I don’t think so. It’s frustrating that no assassins have come after Naofumi-san.”
“Even if I tried to bring them into our group… Motoyasu-kun and Gaelion-chan are more than enough.”
“Are their roles similar…? That’s certainly true. Though the damage to our side has been massive, too.”
“Still, it’s amazing. Rafuemon, Philoko-chan, and Rafumi-chan. Even though they’re all supposed to be siblings, not a single one was created by the same designer.”
“I really can’t understand why they’re so fixated on the sibling setting.”
That’s the kind of conversation my father was having with Itsuki.
This happened a few days later. I heard that my Father had been summoned to the village workshop, so I tagged along. Our Rival was also flitting along behind us.
“Itsuki, is something wrong?”
“Ah, Naofumi-san.”
There, on the workshop bench, Rafuemon lay sprawled out, partially taken apart, while Filoko-chan and Rafumi were fiddling with something, making clattering noises.
“W-what are you doing? Did you mess up? Itsuki… I don’t think it’s right to break Rough-emon just because you don’t like him, you know?”
It certainly looked like they were trying to take him apart.
“No, that’s not it. According to them, they’re performing an upgrade procedure on Rough-emon.”
“That’s right, Itsuki.”
“I confirm that.”
“What do you mean?”
“Are you already planning to make those kinds of modifications?”
Just as I was about to ask, “Isn’t that a bit too soon for a Rival?” my Father shot a questioning glance at the Rival as well.

“As I’ve said before, Rafuemon is an assassin created by a reincarnated person. What’s more, since he was built rather haphazardly with the assumption that he’d self-destruct, his durability wasn’t taken into account.”
“So, he’ll break right away? Was it just shoddy workmanship, or did they not want to invest too much effort in a cannon fodder unit…?”
“Since many reincarnated people are lazy and rely too much on their abilities, their inventions tend to be sloppy.”
“Just like Takt’s paper-making technology, huh.”
It seems the goal is to set civilization back. I suppose this Rafuemon was also thrown together haphazardly.
“With construction like this, we’ll be lucky if it lasts half a year.”
“You’ve read the situation well.”
“Ah, so that means we can avoid a ‘Goodbye, Rafuemon’ scenario. That’s a relief, Itsuki. At least it won’t end up like the fan fiction or urban legend versions.”
“I kind of get what fan fiction version Naofumi-san is referring to, but please don’t drag me into it.”

“Itsuki doesn’t know about that, does he? Oh, but with this setup, does that mean the story will develop into Itsuki having to repair Roughemon? It seems like he knows he can perform life-prolonging measures, though.”
“In the original ‘Wild Naofumi’ version, they were refurbishing it using the technology of this era.”
“So Naofumi-san is the repair guy? Why don’t you just take care of it, Naofumi-san?”
“I’ll respect Rafu-emon’s wishes on that one. So, are you actually carrying out that overhaul right after arriving?”
With a *click-clack* sound, Rafumi nodded as she fiddled with Rafu-emon’s circuits.
“I was planning to do some repairs and modifications along the way to prevent that from happening. Even so, isn’t this a bit early?”
“The sooner, the better. It makes adjustments easier that way.”
“If people said this sloppy work was the technology of the future, it’d be a blow to my pride.”
“Even though your goals are different, it seems you’re both positive about improving Rafuemon.”

“So, after the situation was explained to me, I ended up performing surgery on Rafuemon, but he was really resistant. For some reason, he said he’d go along with it if I were there to watch over him, so I had no choice but to stay and watch…”
“From his perspective, Itsuki is the only one he can rely on. He trusts you that much, so you should watch over him.”
“Well, I guess you’re right.”
“Still, you’d think the two of them would get into a fight over the modification plan… but they don’t, do they?”
In response to Father’s question, Philoko-chan and Rafumi looked at me and nodded.
“We had a discussion back when it was still just blueprints.”
“That’s right, Kyu. Basically, no matter what we do, the original was so terrible that it’s just an upgrade, Kyu. Still, there’s something you should ask the Shield Hero and Bow Hero about, Kyu.”
“What?”
“What is it?”
“Should we remove the ears, Kyu? If we do it now, we can write it into the backstory that they were chewed off by Filolial, so we can take them off, Kyu.”
